title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 459 (Powers of Central Government or Tribunal to accord approval, etc., subject to conditions and to prescribe fees on applications)

content.overview: The Central Government or the Tribunal may accord an approval subject to conditions, and may prescribe fees on applications.

content.study: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 459 (Powers of Central Government or Tribunal to accord approval, etc., subject to conditions and to prescribe fees on applications). The Central Government or the Tribunal may accord an approval subject to conditions, and may prescribe fees on applications. Apply only the conditions, approvals, filings and penalties stated in the section. A rule made under the Act cannot contradict the section. Not a verified closure.

sections.heading: Explanation
sections.body: A condition binds the applicant. Breach of a condition can lead to revocation. The section does not create a new ground of approval.
